<function name="WorldToLocal" parent="PhysObj" type="classfunc">
	<description>Translates a worldspace vector into the physics object's local space.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="vec" type="Vector">A worldspace vector.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The corresponding local space vector.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
